subject: STABLE step 10: command-BO pool + clear-colour slab (bridge .c 756c2546 .h 08df92e0, bridge test 5411ded6, frame_bench.py 9150009e, frame_bench_main.m 6370cd67)
body: Bridge (own functions cmdpool_get/put/reclaim, clear_slot_get; sites: struct bridge, alloc() retry chain, jm_submit/wait_pending/n2mb_wait_seq record reaped id, draw_locked owned[0] (diag draws keep fresh BOs for the VA spacer), draw_batch_locked cmd, n2mb_clear colour): up to 48 mapped internal command BOs / 4 MiB reused once their job id <= reaped (sync WAIT, WAIT_SEQ, wait_seq); LRU replacement of idle entries of other size classes; size window [size, 2*size+16K]; on a broken bridge an entry with a submitted job is released (kernel owns it). n2r_build_impl memsets every block it builds (render.c:435) and unbuilt blocks are never referenced -> no clearing on reuse. Clears use 64-byte slots of one mapped 16 KiB slab (slot reusable after its job is reaped; unknown outcome never reused) instead of a BO per clear. Budget: alloc() now retries after waiting, then cmdpool_reclaim (idle pool entries + idle slab), then code_reclaim. TLS stays per draw (integration requires TLS BO released after wait). API: n2mb_cmdpool_count, n2mb_cmdpool_stats(hits,misses). Tests: bridge test updated (live counts include pool; reuse expectations; budget order pool->code->none; clear faults now need 2 failures because the slab falls back to a per-clear BO) + new block 'command-block pool: reuse only after reap (async+sync), in-flight never handed out, clear slab'. frame_bench: FB_POOL per-frame line, per-job kernel-call table. Result (batched, steady, host fake, async on): kernel calls per kernel job anchor -> now: ca200 7.3->1.0, large 5.9->1.0, medium 5.9->1.0, small 5.5->1.1, tick 6.2->1.2, blur_heavy 7.9->1.1 (alloc/release/map per job 1.2-2.0 -> 0; only SUBMIT + one WAIT_SEQ per command remain); pool hits 100% in steady batched frames (perdraw mode >48 jobs in flight still allocates the excess). Gates: run_host_tests 55 PASS to known stop, CA ASan+release PASS, render harness rc0, async test 6/6, integration 1005/2 (baseline), iOS -Werror syntax rc0. Not hardware verified.
